pages.text:
Syntax: swalk <directions>
              |
              |        Execute a sequence of space-separated movements.
              |        Each token is an optional repeat count followed by a direction.
              |
              |        Valid directions: n  s  e  w  u  d  ne  nw  se  sw
              |
              |        Examples:
              |          swalk 3e 2n 1u 4w    = east x3, north x2, up x1, west x4
              |          swalk ne s e w        = northeast, south, east, west
              |          swalk 3ne 2sw n       = northeast x3, southwest x2, north
              |          swalk 5u              = up five times
              |
              |        Notes:
              |          - Directions must be space-separated
              |          - Each direction token can have an optional leading count (e.g. 3ne)
              |          - You must be standing to use swalk
              |          - Cannot speedwalk while in combat
              |          - Speedwalk stops immediately if a move fails (locked door, no exit, etc)
              |          - Maximum 100 consecutive moves in one speedwalk
              |          - Directions are not case-sensitive
              |
              |        Related: north, south, east, west, up, down,
              |                 northeast, northwest, southeast, southwest
              |
